nodes.label: Track Your Requests - Customer Portal UI Screenshot
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the customer-facing service portal at services.networkingexperts.in showing the 'Track your requests' page. The layout features three top navigation tabs: 'New Request', 'Track Request' (active), and 'Complaint'. The main panel contains a form with a Phone Number input (placeholder +91 98765 43210) and an optional Ticket Number input (placeholder NE-260506-1234), followed by a green 'Show my tickets' CTA button. Left side contains an ad placeholder area. Bottom footer displays urgent support contact info: +91 88991 33144 with 'Call' and 'WhatsApp' action buttons. Color scheme is white with green accents on a light green gradient background.
ui_patterns: form with phone number and ticket number inputs
urgent support footer with call and WhatsApp CTAs
design_decisions: Green primary color for active tab and CTA button
Phone number as primary identifier for ticket lookup
Optional ticket number for direct ticket access
WhatsApp as support channel alongside phone call
Minimal, clean layout with left ad space
nodes.purpose: Allow customers to look up and track their service/support tickets by entering their phone number, with optional direct ticket number access
